ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { subject: payload.subject, description: payload.description, category: payload.category, product: payload.product, customerId: payload.customerId, customerTier: payload.customerTier, severity: payload.severity, contactEmail: payload.contactEmail, requestId: payload.requestId }

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, Category_Code__c, Product_Code__c, Customer_Tier__c, Stated_Severity__c, Assigned_Priority__c, Assigned_Team__c, Queue_Name__c, Ack_SLA_Minutes__c, Is_Active__c, Rule_Priority__c FROM Routing_Rule__c WHERE Is_Active__c = true ORDER BY Rule_Priority__c ASC

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var ticket = vars.ticketRequest var rules = payload
var matchingRules = rules filter (r) -> r.Is_Active__c == true and (r.Category_Code__c == ticket.category or r.Category_Code__c == "ALL") and (r.Product_Code__c == ticket.product or r.Product_Code__c == "ALL") and (r.Customer_Tier__c == (ticket.customerTier default "STANDARD") or r.Customer_Tier__c == "ALL") and (r.Stated_Severity__c == ticket.severity or r.Stated_Severity__c == "ALL")
var selectedRule = if (isEmpty(matchingRules)) ((rules filter (r) -> r.Name == "RR-099")[0] default {}) else matchingRules[0]
--- [ { Subject__c: ticket.subject, Description__c: ticket.description, Category_Code__c: ticket.category, Product_Code__c: ticket.product, Customer_ID__c: ticket.customerId, Stated_Severity__c: ticket.severity, Contact_Email__c: ticket.contactEmail, Request_ID__c: ticket.requestId, Ticket_Status__c: "New", Priority__c: selectedRule.Assigned_Priority__c default "P3", Assigned_Team__c: selectedRule.Assigned_Team__c default "TRIAGE" } ]
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Ticket creation processed", result: payload }
